game_integration.modifications: Single shot E_25P.wav from 0.513917s to 3.063917s; 48kHz mono PCM16, 80ms tail fade, peak -6dBFS. Source labels Arisaka .30-06; tonal reference, not verified original 6.5/7.7mm service ammunition.
Grass/dirt footstep derived by congusbongus from swuing. 48kHz mono PCM16, peak -14dBFS, 5ms edge fades.

Blender Foundation / Yo Frankie forest and wind blended 72:28 after RMS balancing. Wind wraps with 400ms crossfade; final ambience loop with 600ms crossfade and 2ms cosine seam fades to exact zero endpoints. 48kHz mono PCM16, RMS approximately -28dBFS, peak capped at -12dBFS.
